import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 15;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int[][][][] gridDist = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] flowCap = new int[400][400];
    static char[][] labGrid = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reactGrid = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dirs = {{1,0},{0,1},{-1,0},{0,-1}};
    static int iterMark = 3;
    static int[] visitMark = new int[400];

    static int nGrid, timeLimit;

    static int augment(int node, int dest, int bottleneck) {
        if (node == dest) return bottleneck;
        if (visitMark[node] == iterMark) return 0;
        visitMark[node] = iterMark;
        for (int next = 0; next <= dest; ++next) {
            if (flowCap[node][next] > 0) {
                int pushed = augment(next, dest, Math.min(bottleneck, flowCap[node][next]));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    flowCap[node][next] -= pushed;
                    flowCap[next][node] += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int nodeID(int x, int y) {
        return (x-1)*nGrid + (y-1);
    }

    static int[][] canSpreadArr = new int[13][13];
    static int[][] tempSpread = new int[13][13];

    static void spread(int mark) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(canSpreadArr[i], 0, tempSpread[i], 0, 13);
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= nGrid; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= nGrid; ++y) {
                if (tempSpread[x][y] == mark) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nx = x + dirs[d][0];
                        int ny = y + dirs[d][1];
                        if (nx >= 1 && ny >= 1 && nx <= nGrid && ny <= nGrid && canSpreadArr[nx][ny] < mark && labGrid[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            canSpreadArr[nx][ny] = mark;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean isReachable(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int infx, int infy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(canSpreadArr[i], 0);
        }
        canSpreadArr[sx][sy] = 1;
        canSpreadArr[infx][infy] = 2;
        for (int step = 0; step < 100; ++step) {
            spread(1);
            if (canSpreadArr[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            spread(2);
            if (canSpreadArr[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        nGrid = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int infx = -1, infy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_N; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAX_N; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < MAX_N; l++) {
                        gridDist[i][j][k][l] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= nGrid; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            labGrid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= nGrid; ++j) {
                gridDist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (labGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i; 
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= nGrid; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            reactGrid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= nGrid; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= nGrid; ++j) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int ni = i + dirs[d][0];
                    int nj = j + dirs[d][1];
                    if (ni >= 1 && nj >= 1 && ni <= nGrid && nj <= nGrid) {
                        if (labGrid[i][j] != 'Y' && labGrid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            gridDist[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int k = 1; k <= nGrid; ++k) {
            for (int l = 1; l <= nGrid; ++l) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= nGrid; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= nGrid; ++j) {
                        for (int u = 1; u <= nGrid; ++u) {
                            for (int v = 1; v <= nGrid; ++v) {
                                gridDist[i][j][u][v] = Math.min(gridDist[i][j][u][v], gridDist[i][j][k][l] + gridDist[k][l][u][v]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int src = nGrid * nGrid * 2 + 1;
        int dst = nGrid * nGrid * 2 + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= nGrid; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= nGrid; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(labGrid[i][j])) {
                    flowCap[src][nodeID(i,j)] = labGrid[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reactGrid[i][j])) {
                    flowCap[nGrid*nGrid + nodeID(i,j)][dst] = reactGrid[i][j] - '0';
                }
                
                if (Character.isDigit(labGrid[i][j])) {
                    for (int u = 1; u <= nGrid; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= nGrid; ++v) {
                            if (labGrid[i][j] > '0' && reactGrid[u][v] > '0') {
                                if (Character.isDigit(reactGrid[u][v]) && gridDist[i][j][u][v] <= timeLimit && isReachable(i,j,u,v,infx,infy)) {
                                    flowCap[nodeID(i,j)][nGrid*nGrid + nodeID(u,v)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int totalFlow = 0;
        int push;
        while ((push = augment(src, dst, 1000)) != 0) {
            totalFlow += push;
            ++iterMark;
        }
        
        System.out.println(totalFlow);
    }
}
